Rashi on Niddah 53a:10:1.hebrew: אלא פשיטא - דנראין דברי חכמים כשבדקה דקאמר רבי, שבדקה בשניהם קאמר. אבל באחד מהן, דקאמרי אינהו נמי לא חיישא, איני רואה דבריהם, דכיון דלא בדקה בדר' יוסי, יש לחוש לראיית בין השמשות. אלמא, לרבי ספקא הוא, כו':
Rashi on Niddah 53a:10:1.english: Rather, it is obvious - That [when] Rabbi says, "The words of the Sages appear correct when she examined," he means that she examined during both of them. But in [a case where she examined during only] one of them, where they [the Sages] say that [in this case] as well she is not concerned, [Rabbi means,] "I do not see their words [as correct]," for since she did not examine during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yosei, one must be concerned about a sighting at twilight. Evidently, according to Rabbi, it is an uncertainty, etc.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:12:1.hebrew: ה"ק - האי "נראין" דקאמר רבי, לאו לטעמיה דנפשיה קאמר, דתידוק מינה: מדקאמר "בזו אני רואה את דברי זה ובזו איני רואה", מכלל דאינהו בתרוייהו פליגי, ותקשי לך; אלא רבי לפרושי פלוגתייהו אתא, לאשמועינן במאי פליגי. וה"ק: נראין דברי ר' יהודה לחכמים, ומודים לו דחיישינן כשלא בדקה, לא בזה ולא בזה; שדברי חכמים — כשבדקה באחד מהני, דקסברי: בין השמשות דרבי יוסי ליליא הוא, ורבי יוסי לטעמיה, דאמר: ספקא הוא, הילכך עד שתבדוק בשניהם יש לחוש בראיית בין השמשות:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:12:1.english: This is what he is saying - This [word] "appear" that Rabbi said — he was not speaking according to his own reasoning, such that you would infer from it: since he said "In this [case] I see the words of this one, and in this [case] I do not see [his words]," it follows that they disagree in both [cases], and it would pose a difficulty for you. Rather, Rabbi came to explain their dispute, to inform us what they disagree about. And this is what he is saying: The words of Rabbi Yehuda appear [correct] to the Sages, and they concede to him that we are concerned when she did not examine, neither during this [twilight] nor during that [twilight]; whereas the words of the Sages [apply] when she examined during one of these, for they maintain: Rabbi Yose's twilight is night. And Rabbi Yose follows his own reasoning, as he said: it is an uncertainty; therefore, until she examines during both of them, there is reason to be concerned about an emission at twilight.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:13:1.english: For a large sighting - [The size of] three split beans with additions.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:13:2.english: For a small sighting - [The size of] two split beans with [their] additions.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:14:2.english: Who did not separate in purity - On the seventh [day], that she did not examine [herself] during twilight.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:14:3.hebrew: לא תהא בחזקת טומאה - ואינה טובלת לערב, ואע"פ שהפרישה בטהרה שחרית. אלמא משראתה הויא כל היום בחזקת חוזרת ורואה עד גמר היום. אף זו, הואיל ולא בדקה בין השמשות שלם, איכא למיחש דלמא בסוף בין השמשות ראתה, והיא עולה לשתי ראיות:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:14:3.english: Would she not be in the presumption of ritual impurity - And she does not immerse in the evening, even though she separated in purity in the morning. Evidently, from the time she saw [blood], she is presumed throughout the entire day to see [blood] again until the end of the day. So too this [woman], since she did not examine [herself] throughout the entire twilight period, there is reason to be concerned that perhaps she saw [blood] at the end of twilight, and it counts as two sightings.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:14:4.english: And his words appear [correct] to me - And I agree with him.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:14:5.hebrew: כשבדקה - בין השמשות שלם, תו לא חיישא; ובשלא בדקה, אני חולק עליו:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:14:5.english: When she examined - [Throughout] the entire twilight, she is no longer concerned; and when she did not examine, I disagree with him.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:17:1.english: [One statement of] Rabbi Yehuda poses a difficulty for [another statement of] Rabbi Yehuda - For above, he holds [that] the twilight of Rabbi Yosei is an uncertainty.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:18:1.hebrew: בשלמא בלא רבי - אי לא פירש רבי לפלוגתייהו בין לעיל בין הכא, לא הוה קשיא דרבי יהודה אדר' יהודה: התם דבדקה כו':
Rashi on Niddah 53a:18:1.english: Granted, without Rabbi - If Rabbi had not explained their dispute, both above and here, [one statement of] Rabbi Yehuda would not pose a difficulty for [the other statement of] Rabbi Yehuda: [as one could explain,] "There, she examined," etc.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:18:2.hebrew: אלא בדרבי - מכי אתא רבי לפרושי פלוגתייהו, ולא מתוקמא לן אלא כדפירשה, דלרבי יהודה דלעיל ספיקא הוא, והכא מיתחזי דליליא הוא, קשיא:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:18:2.english: Rather, according to Rabbi - Once Rabbi came to explain their dispute, and it can only be established by us as he explained it, that according to Rabbi Yehuda [bar Ilai, mentioned] earlier, it is an uncertainty, whereas here it appears that it is night, [this poses] a difficulty:

Rashi on Niddah 53a:1:1.english: Rabbi said: It appears, etc. - [The Gemara] explains all of it.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:2:1.english: Here we are dealing with - [In] the dispute between the Rabbis and Rabbi Yehuda ben Agra.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:2:2.english: When she examined herself - Throughout both twilights.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:2:3.hebrew: ולא בדקה חלוקה - בשני ימים, אלא בג', ומצאה ב' גריסין. ולפי שלא בדקה חלוקה עד הנה, לא ידעה מאימת הן באין. לפיכך יש לחוש שמא בשני בין השמשות ראתה, או אחת ביום ראשון ואחת בין השמשות של מחר, דהוו להו ג' ראיות:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:2:3.english: And she did not examine her robe - [She did not examine it] on the [first] two days, but rather on the third [day], and found two gris[-sized stains]. And since she did not examine her robe until now, she does not know from when they came. Therefore, there is reason to be concerned lest she saw [them] during the two twilights, or [she saw] one on the first day and one during the twilight of the next day, so that they constitute three sightings.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:2:4.hebrew: בין השמשות דרבי יהודה - בבמה מדליקין: הכסיף העליון ולא הכסיף התחתון, ושיעורו חצי מיל. ולר' יוסי כהרף עין, ובסוף היום הוא - זה נכנס וזה יוצא:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:2:4.english: The twilight of Rabbi Yehuda - [In the chapter] Bameh Madlikin [Shabbat 34b]: The upper [sky] has paled and the lower has not paled, and its duration is [the time needed to walk] half a mil. And according to Rabbi Yosei, [twilight is] like the blink of an eye, and it is at the end of the day - this [night] enters and that [day] departs.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:3:1.hebrew: והא בדקה בבין השמשות דרבי יהודה - הלכך לא ראתה אחת מהן בין השמשות, שתעלה לחומר ב' ימים:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:3:1.english: And behold, she examined [herself] during the twilight of Rabbi Yehuda - Therefore, she did not see either of them [i.e., the sightings] at twilight, such that it would count for the stringency of two days.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:3:2.hebrew: ספקא הוא - דחיישינן שמא לאחר סילוק ידיה בבין השמשות דרבי יוסי חזאי, והוא עולה לשני ימים, והוו להו שלשה ימים רצופים. ולרבנן לילה הוא, ואפילו חזאי לא הוו להו שלשה ראיות:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:3:2.english: It is an uncertainty - For we are concerned that perhaps after removing her hands, during Rabbi Yosei's twilight, she saw [blood], and it counts for two days, and they become three consecutive days. And according to the Rabbis, it is night, and even if she saw [blood], they would not amount to three sightings.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:4:1.english: Had her hands been in her eyes - In that place [i.e., her private parts].

Rashi on Niddah 53a:4:2.english: The entire twilight - [That] of Rabbi Yehuda.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:4:4.english: Say that upon the removal of her hands she saw [blood] - For Rabbi Yehuda's twilight is long.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:5:1.english: The words of Rabbi Yehuda appear [correct] - That he is concerned [about the possibility].

Rashi on Niddah 53a:5:2.hebrew: בשלא בדקה - ומדקאמר רבי בהא ס"ל כרבי יהודה, אבל בשבדקה לא ס"ל כוותיה, מכלל דרבי יהודה בן אגרא אפילו בדקה נמי חייש. ומאי לא בדקה? אי נימא ה"ק רבי: רואה אני את דברי ר' יהודה בשלא בדקה בדרבי יוסי, ואע"ג דבדקה בדר' יהודה, דאיכא לספוקי בבין השמשות דרבי יוסי, אבל איני רואה את דבריו כשבדקה בשניהם:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:5:2.english: In [a case] where she did not examine - And since Rabbi said [that] in this [case] he holds in accordance with Rabbi Yehuda [ben Agra], but in [a case] where she examined he does not hold in accordance with him, it follows by inference that Rabbi Yehuda ben Agra is concerned even if she examined. And what is [meant by] "she did not examine"? If we say that this is what Rabbi is saying: "I accept the words of Rabbi Yehuda [ben Agra] where she did not examine during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yosei, even though she examined during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yehuda, for there is [reason] to be in doubt regarding the twilight of Rabbi Yosei; but I do not accept his words when she examined during both of them."

Rashi on Niddah 53a:6:1.hebrew: מכלל דרבי יהודה אפילו בדקה בתרוייהו - חייש? הא ודאי בין השמשות לא חזאי, ואין לך לחלוק ראיה אחת לשתים:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:6:1.english: By inference, that Rabbi Yehuda [holds that] even if she examined during both of them - [Is he] concerned?! Behold, she certainly did not see [blood] during twilight, and you cannot divide a single sighting into two.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:7:1.hebrew: אלא פשיטא דלא בדקה לא - בהא ולא בהא, דחוששת שמא ראתה בבין השמשות דר' יהודה:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:7:1.english: Rather, it is obvious that she did not examine, neither - In this [twilight period] nor in that one, for she must be concerned lest she saw [blood] during the twilight of Rabbi Yehuda.

Rashi on Niddah 53a:7:2.english: But if she examined during [the twilight] of Rabbi Yehuda - [Rabbi means:] "I do not see his words [as correct] to be concerned about zivah."

Rashi on Niddah 53a:8:1.hebrew: אלמא - קסבר רבי בין השמשות דרבי יוסי לילה הוא, והראייה שבה אינה עולה לשתים:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:8:1.english: Evidently - Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] holds that Rabbi Yosei's twilight is nighttime, and a sighting during it does not count as two [sightings].

Rashi on Niddah 53a:9:1.hebrew: אי נימא כשבדקה בדרבי יהודה ולא בדרבי יוסי - וקאמר רבי: בזו אני רואה את דבריהם דלא חיישינן, אבל לא בדקה לא בזו ולא בזו — איני רואה את דבריהם, דאנא סבירא לי דחיישא:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:9:1.english: If we say when she examined during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yehuda and not during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yosei - And Rabbi is saying: "In this [case], I see their words [as correct], that we are not concerned; but if she did not examine [herself], neither during this [twilight] nor during that [twilight], I do not see their words [as correct], for I hold that she must be concerned."

Rashi on Niddah 53a:9:2.hebrew: מכלל דלרבנן אע"ג דלא בדקה לא בהא ולא בהא לא חיישא, והא לא בדקה - ויש לחוש לראיית בין השמשות המתחלקת לשתים:
Rashi on Niddah 53a:9:2.english: By inference, that according to the Rabbis, even though she did not examine [herself], neither during this [twilight] nor during that [twilight], she is not concerned? But behold, she did not examine! - And there is reason to be concerned about a sighting during twilight, which is divided into two.

Tosafot on Niddah 53a:12:1.hebrew: שאף חכמים לא נחלקו כו' - בכמה דוכתין משני כי הכא. אבל בפרק הזהב (ב"מ דף נד.) גבי חומש ומעשר, ובפרק כל הבשר (חולין דף קט.) גבי אפשר לסוחטו, לא משני הכי, משום שיכול ליישב בענין אחר בהגהה מועטת:
Tosafot on Niddah 53a:12:1.english: For even the Sages did not disagree, etc. - In several places, [the Gemara] answers as [it does] here. But in [the chapter] HaZahav (Bava Metzia 54a) regarding the [additional] fifth and the tithe, and in [the chapter] Kol HaBasar (Chullin 109a) regarding [the principle of] "it is possible to squeeze it out" (efshar le-soḥato), [the Gemara] does not answer like this, because it can resolve [the difficulty] in another manner with a slight emendation.

Tosafot on Niddah 53a:14:1.hebrew: ומה אילו נדה שלא הפרישה כו' - וא"ת, דבפ"ב (דף סח:) לקמן א"ר יוסי גופיה דהיא בחזקתה? וי"ל, דהתם מיירי כשבדקה יום ב' או יום ג' ומצאתה טהורה שפסקה, והכא בדלא בדקה. א"נ, הכא מיירי שבדקה שחרית של שביעי ומצאתה טמא:
Tosafot on Niddah 53a:14:1.english: And what if a menstruating woman did not separate, etc. - And if you say that in the last chapter (daf 68b) below, Rabbi Yosei himself said that she is in her presumptive status [of purity]? And one can say that there, it is dealing with [a case] where she examined [herself on] the second day or the third day and found [herself] pure, [demonstrating] that [her bleeding] had ceased, whereas here, [it is dealing with a case] where she did not examine [herself]. Alternatively, here it is dealing with [a case] where she examined [herself on] the morning of the seventh [day] and found [herself] impure.

Tosafot on Niddah 53a:16:1.hebrew: מכלל דרבי יהודה בן אגרא סבר בדקה בדר' יהודה ולא בדקה בדרבי יוסי אינה חוששת - השתא הוה מצי למיפרך: הא משמיה דרבי יוסי קאמר. וא"ת: ואימא מכלל דרבי יהודה בן אגרא סבר, דבדקה בדר' יוסי גרידא אינה חוששת, ורבי סבר חוששת, כיון דלא בדקה בדרבי יהודה, דבין השמשות דרבי יוסי מישך שייך בדר' יהודה, כדאמר בסוף; והשתא, לא הוה צריך למימר תרי תנאי ואליבא דר' יהודה בן אגרא? וי"ל: דומיא דברייתא דלעיל, דמיירי רבי יהודה בן אגרא כשבדקה בדרבי יהודה ולא בדקה בדרבי יוסי:
Tosafot on Niddah 53a:16:1.english: By inference, Rabbi Yehuda ben Agra holds [that if] she examined during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yehuda and did not examine during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yosei, she is not concerned - Now, [the Gemara] could have objected: But he stated [this] in the name of Rabbi Yosei! And if you say: Why not say [instead that] by inference Rabbi Yehuda ben Agra holds that [if] she examined during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yosei alone, she is not concerned, and Rabbi holds she is concerned since she did not examine during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yehuda — for the twilight of Rabbi Yosei is subsumed within [that of] Rabbi Yehuda, as [the Gemara] says at the end — and now, [the Gemara] would not have needed to say [that there are] two Tanna'im according to Rabbi Yehuda ben Agra? And one can answer: [It is established] analogous to the *baraita* above, where Rabbi Yehuda ben Agra was dealing with [a case] where she examined during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yehuda and did not examine during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yosei.

Tosafot on Niddah 53a:7:1.hebrew: אבל בדקה בדרבי יהודה כו' - וא"ת: דלמא אבל בדקה בדרבי יוסי ולא בדקה בדר' יהודה, לא חיישינן, דבין השמשות דר' יהודה יממא הוא? וי"ל, דבהא ר' יהודה בן אגרא מודה דלא חיישינן, כיון דבדקה דדר' יוסי:
Tosafot on Niddah 53a:7:1.english: But [if] she examined during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yehuda, etc. - And if you say: Perhaps [we should say]: But [if] she examined during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yosei and did not examine during [the twilight of] Rabbi Yehuda, we are not concerned, for the twilight of Rabbi Yehuda is daytime? And one can say that in this [case], Rabbi Yehuda ben Agra concedes that we are not concerned, since she examined [during the twilight] of Rabbi Yosei.
